prompts.description: Fix Tailwind v4 CSS build error: load Pretendard via a <link> in layout instead of a remote @import in globals.css
prompts.prompt:
A remote @import in app/globals.css broke the Tailwind v4 / Lightning CSS build. Fix it by loading Pretendard through a <link> in the layout instead. Edit TWO files:
(A) app/globals.css — REMOVE the line `@import url('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/orioncactus/pretendard@v1.3.9/dist/web/variable/pretendardvariable-dynamic-subset.min.css');` if it is present (it must be deleted entirely; do not leave any remote @import in this file). Ensure the `--font-sans` custom property reads exactly: `--font-sans: "Pretendard Variable", "Pretendard", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Segoe UI", sans-serif;` (set it to this if it is currently anything else). Do NOT change --font-mono, color tokens, or anything else in this file.
(B) app/layout.tsx — the root layout already returns an `<html>` containing a `<head>` element with a dark-mode `<script>`. Inside that existing `<head>`, immediately before the closing `</head>`, add these two tags exactly:
        <link rel="preconnect" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net" crossOrigin="anonymous" />
        <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/orioncactus/pretendard@v1.3.9/dist/web/variable/pretendardvariable-dynamic-subset.min.css" />
Do NOT modify the metadata export, the dark-mode script, the <body>, or anything else. Do NOT add any @import to globals.css. Do NOT install any npm package. Verify: `npm run build` passes with no CSS error, and after a hard refresh Korean text and numbers render in Pretendard (rounder, more even than system gothic).
